Subject: CSA evidence intake — initial ask

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for taking this on. SummitAI is running a CSA assessment next month and we need a compact CAIQ package to present to our security team. High-level asks: 
- Completed CAIQ mapping (spreadsheet) tied to Redwood controls
- Network diagram showing tenancy and egress paths
- Evidence for a few controls: key management (encryption at rest), runtime logging samples, and tenant isolation assertions
- SOC 2 report (redacted OK) and contact for any attestation clarifications

Target timeline: can you confirm whether you can share the spreadsheet + diagram by EOD Friday? Procurement may follow up for an NDA or DocuSign if needed.

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a quick 20m call if that helps.

Best,
Alex

Perfect — thanks Hannah. A couple quick clarifications inline:

Procurement: we will get an NDA over if needed; otherwise the Drive link will be fine for now. Can you confirm whether HSM rotation policy is customer-visible (ie, redacted is fine), or if you need us to request a specific attestation?

Happy to take the SOC 2 link when it's ready. If it's easier we can accept a redacted PDF in Drive.

Thanks again — will circle back after procurement confirms NDA.

—Alex

Can one of you own pulling the HSM policy and confirm whether we need legal redaction? Can the infra team pull a 48h runtime slice and upload anonymized sample to the Drive folder?

- Marissa: coordinate infra for runtime log extract and provide sample by EOD Monday

Hannah
